MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Reusable cable ties fit my collection of wired accessories because they could help organize connections I already use, although a pack of 100 exceeds my needs.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my interest in practical connection accessories, but it would only become a useful purchase if I needed that specific connection."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The CPU cooler and case fan assume I am upgrading or repairing a desktop, while my purchases show individual accessories bought for specific purposes.",
    "The internal drive, SATA cable and mounting kit depend on a storage installation I have no reason to undertake right now.",
    "The external drive, mouse and memory card could be useful in some circumstances, but I have no current storage, replacement or memory expansion need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying a desktop USB expansion card seems to have been treated as an ongoing interest in internal computer upgrades.",
    "My use of USB devices and tablet accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in other products sharing those connections, regardless of their purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases are spread across years and address distinct practical needs; they do not suggest an active shopping project.",
    "The exact connection and task matter to me: needing DVI or Ethernet does not automatically mean I need HDMI, SATA or additional storage.",
    "I rarely interact unless something addresses a relevant need, so a broadly related accessory is usually insufficient."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in practical accessories but assume upgrade and replacement needs that my history does not establish."
}
